{{Quote|I've long suspected that you have the gift your father and I share, and now I know it to be true. It's a strange, wondrous power, Hego, and you have it in abundance. Your father and I have spent our lives keeping our gifts a closely guarded secret, and I want your word that for the time being you will speak of it only to me or to him. Later in life this power will serve you well, but right now it must remain undisclosed.|Darth Plagueis' mother|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''mother''' of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. She was a [[Dark side adept/Legends|disciple]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. She was instructed to seduce [[Caar Damask]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and [[Reproduction/Legends|carry]] his child. According to the plan, she became Damask's [[Codicil partner|codicil wife]] and bore him a son, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], who she raised with great care. After Hego [[Death/Legends|murdered]] one of his [[Unidentified Muun youngling|playmates]], she made him state his feelings on the death of the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], before telling him that he had the same "gift" she and his father had.

Just before Hego was handed over to Tenebrous to become his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], Plagueis' mother told the young Muun that in some ways he would eventually come to understand, he belonged to Tenebrous. Later, Hego's mother disappeared without a trace.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Plagueis' mother was first mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
